name: Sonsbeck (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, blue and yellow below a white banner head bearing the municipal arms of Sonsbeck (a red figure on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of Düsseldorf of 9 September 1970 the municipality of Sonsbeck was granted the right to bear arms, a banner and a seal; the flag (banner) is striped lengthwise 1:1:1 in yellow, blue and yellow.

features.role: Sonsbeck arms — red figure on white
